    if not resp:
        break
    downloaded.extend(resp)
    page_index+=1

downloaded_song_ids=set(s['song_id'] for s in downloaded)

downloaded_by_album={}
for s in downloaded:
    aid=s['album_id']

# fetch album library and evaluate downloaded duration per album
albums=[]

page_limit=20

    resp=apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=tok,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)

    albums.extend(resp)

from collections import defaultdict

for a in albums:
    aid=a['album_id']
    # sum durations for downloaded tracks in this album
    dur=sum(s['duration'] for s in downloaded_by_album.get(aid,[]))
    album_download_dur[aid]=dur

# choose album with dur >= 900 seconds and maximize dur
cands=[aid for aid,dur in album_download_dur.items() if dur>=15*60]

# get album track order and select downloaded tracks (all of them)

sel_dur=sum(t['duration'] for t in sel)
print('Selected total duration',sel_dur)

# build verification table with title/artists/duration and downloaded status
for t in sel:
    artists=', '.join([ar['name'] for ar in t['artists']])
    print(' -',t['title'],'|',artists,'|',t['duration'],'sec')

selected_song_ids=[t['id'] for t in sel]
print('selected_song_ids',selected_song_ids)

token=apis.spotify.login(username='as_moore@gmail.com', password=pw)['access_token']

# fetch all downloaded songs
all_downloads=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_downloaded_songs(access_token=token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_downloads.extend(resp)
    page_index+=1

downloaded_song_ids=set(s['song_id'] for s in all_downloads)
print('downloaded_song_count',len(downloaded_song_ids))

# fetch all albums in album library
all_albums=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=20)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_albums.extend(resp)
    page_index+=1
print('album_library_count',len(all_albums))

TARGET=15*60
cands=[]
for a in all_albums:
    aid=a['album_id']
    album=apis.spotify.show_album(album_id=aid)
    tracks=album['songs']
    selected=[]
    cum=0
    for t in tracks:
        if t['id'] in downloaded_song_ids:
            selected.append(t)
            cum+=t['duration']
        if cum>=TARGET:
            break
    if cum>=TARGET:
        cands.append({
            'album_id':aid,
            'album_title':album['title'],
            'selected_tracks':len(selected),
            'selected_duration':cum,
            'total_album_tracks':len(tracks),
            'selected_track_ids':[t['id'] for t in selected]
        })

print('eligible_albums',len(cands))
# choose album with minimal selected_tracks, then minimal extra duration over TARGET
if not cands:
    print('NO eligible albums found')
else:
    # compute tie-break
    for c in cands:
        c['extra']=c['selected_duration']-TARGET
    c_sorted=sorted(cands, key=lambda x:(x['selected_tracks'], x['extra']))
    best=c_sorted[0]
    print('best',best)

    # print verification table for best album
    album=apis.spotify.show_album(album_id=best['album_id'])
    downloaded_in_album=[(i+1,t['title'],', '.join([ar['name'] for ar in t['artists']]),t['duration'],t['id']) for i,t in enumerate(album['songs']) if t['id'] in downloaded_song_ids]
    # selection by album order until cum>=TARGET
    cum=0
    sel_rows=[]
    for i,t in enumerate(album['songs']):
        if t['id'] in downloaded_song_ids:
            artists=', '.join([ar['name'] for ar in t['artists']])
            sel_rows.append((len(sel_rows)+1,i+1,t['title'],artists,t['duration'],t['id']))
            cum+=t['duration']
            if cum>=TARGET:
                break
    print('Selection verification rows:')
    for row in sel_rows:
        print(row)
    print('cum_seconds',cum)
